name: Hearchco - Frontend
description: Hearchco is a distributed and fast metasearch engine that respects your privacy.
requires: This is the frontend for the Hearchco metasearch engine. It requires an agent to also be running.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Publicly accessible URL for the frontend, used to advertise service. Replace with your domain.

variables.name: Agent URL
variables.description: URL for the agent, used to communicate with the backend. Replace with IP address or domain.

variables.name: Public Agent URL
variables.description: Publicly accessible URL for the agent, used to fetch data from browser. Replace with your domain.
